sections.title: Cine World
sections.description: Enter Cine World, frame the shot, start your recorder, then roll a take. F8 rolls, F9 cancels or leaves, F10 cycles the frame guide, F7 saves the current view as the final shot.

controls.label: Status
controls.description: What CINE is doing now.

controls.label: Enter Cine World
controls.description: Closes the menu and hides the game HUD. Nothing else changes until you roll a take.

controls.label: Roll a take
controls.description: Closes the menu and starts the selected preset after the countdown. Same as F8 in Cine World.

controls.label: Leave Cine World
controls.description: Ends any take and restores the HUD, the camera and the walk settings. Same as F9.

controls.label: Countdown
controls.description: Seconds between rolling and action, to start your recorder. The countdown is shown small in a corner; trim it from the video.

sections.title: Shot
sections.description: Presets are JSON files in this extension's presets folder. Copy one, edit it and use Reload presets.

controls.label: Preset
controls.description: The camera recipe for the take.

controls.label: About this preset
controls.description: The preset's own description.

controls.label: Distance
controls.description: Moves every camera closer or further.

controls.label: Height
controls.description: Raises or lowers every camera and its aim together.

controls.label: Field of view
controls.description: Wider or tighter lens. Portrait (9:16) recordings usually want about 1.25x.

controls.label: Frame guide
controls.description: Darkens everything outside the chosen frame while you set up. Hidden during takes, so it never ends up in a recording.

controls.label: Ease in at walls
controls.description: Checks the camera path before the take and moves the camera closer where a wall would block it, instead of jumping to her other side.

controls.label: Reload presets
controls.description: Reads the presets folder again. Broken files are skipped and named in the CSSX log.

sections.title: Route
sections.description: Walk shots follow a route you walk once. The final shot is the game camera's view where the walk should end.

controls.label: Route
controls.description: The saved route.

controls.label: Record route
controls.description: Closes the menu. Walk the route, then stand still for 3 seconds. F9 cancels.

controls.label: Final shot
controls.description: The saved last shot.

controls.label: Use the current view as final shot
controls.description: Closes the menu and saves the game camera's view 1.5 seconds later. Stand her where the walk should end and frame it with the game camera first. F7 does the same in Cine World.

sections.title: Clean scene
sections.description: Takes the people around you out of the picture while you are in Cine World. The world keeps running: time, weather, effects and your own character are untouched. Everyone comes back exactly as they were when you leave.

controls.label: Hide
controls.description: Hidden characters are frozen, cannot be hit and cannot hurt you, and new ones do not spawn while this is on. Bosses are left alone. With nobody kept you also cannot be hurt or noticed while it is on.

controls.label: Keep my lock-on target
controls.description: Leaves the enemy you are locked on to in the scene, so you can film a fight with just that one. The fight is real: it can see you and hurt you.

controls.label: Now
controls.description: What clean scene is doing.

sections.title: Breakdown
sections.description: Shows the take in layers like a VFX breakdown reel: clay, wireframe, skeleton, bones, collision and the frame passes, wiped in one after another. Works on any preset. Needs CINE's asset pak installed.

controls.label: Breakdown track
controls.description: Built-in reel: runs through every layer over the length of the take and ends on the final image. From the preset: breakdown steps written in the preset file.

controls.label: Labels and arrows
controls.description: Names what each layer shows, with an arrow to it, and a caption with the layers on screen.

controls.label: Include my lock-on target
controls.description: Also breaks down the enemy you are locked on to when the take starts.

controls.label: This take
controls.description: What the breakdown track will do.

sections.title: Look
sections.description: Needs Custom Shell System 1.0.0-beta.9 or newer. Your own customization is saved before the take and put back after it.

controls.label: Look track
controls.description: Cycle palettes: every palette of the worn outfit in turn, then your own look. From the preset: look steps written in a preset file; the shipped presets have none.

controls.label: This take
controls.description: What the look track will do.
